summary: The Leonardo.Ai free plan grants 150 fast tokens every day (resetting daily) for image generation on the app's core models. Slow-generation modes can stretch usage further at zero cost.
claim_steps: Create a free Leonardo.Ai account at leonardo.ai.
Confirm your email to activate the free plan.
Generate images from the app dashboard using your daily fast tokens.
Return daily — the 150 fast-token allowance resets every day.
